domain: observability, performance engineering, and agent workload economics
axioms: Every metric defines a system boundary, and work outside that boundary can invalidate the apparent improvement.
A ratio can improve because its denominator worsens even when its numerator does not.
Resource efficiency is meaningful only relative to a normalized workload and a successful outcome.
Attribution must be captured at event time because retrospective transcript classification is expensive and ambiguous.
Unknown accounting rules require sensitivity analysis rather than a single cost ranking.
Once a proxy becomes a gate, implementations adapt to the proxy unless independent guardrails constrain them.
failure_mode: It can undervalue rare correctness failures whose expected cost is hard to estimate from three pilots.
It may turn an exploratory pilot into an instrumentation project and delay learning through excessive measurement demands.
It cannot judge frozen-criterion completeness or distributed-state safety without evidence from the sibling lenses.
